components.finding: District orderApril18 2022 rawpages58–59 vacatesCDC Mask Mandate and remands; President is terminated as defendant. EleventhCircuitJune22 2023 page11 vacates district order/judgment and directs dismissal as moot after CDC mandate expirationMay11 2023. It does not affirm the merits or revive expiredCDC rules. Appellate mandate date is not independently supplied.

CDC January29 order applies its own42USC264 authorities and own termination conditions. DHS January27 determination directsTSA under49USC114; TSOB ratification and FTA bulletin evidence actual mode-specific implementation/nonenforcement. Their scope does not establish every agency command or later repeal.

FRA32 expressly implements13998 andCDC but has an internal date issue: front DATES March1 2021 versus final effective-upon-issuance clause and February24 signature. Preserve conflict; do not silently pick an earliest universal performance date.

CDC January25 air-test revision supersedesJanuary12, effectiveJanuary26 and subject to its own sunset/modification. June10 2022 rescission applies to flights departing at or afterJune12 12:01amEDT. This ends that requirement, not all13998 international directions. Proclamation10575 partially revokes10294 exceptsections1,6,7,8 effectiveMay12 2023 12:01amEDT, independently.

CDC December1 2025 archived-orders page supplies secondary official chronology of separate contact-information, China testing, and cruise regimes; underlying complete orders/rescissions are needed before exact native ending adoption. It is not proof that every13998 task ended.
The sec2-c-dup2 frozen row is continuation of section2(e), not a new exception command. Complete original confirms the proposed mapping.
